subject: Multishift bootcamp — aligning hands-on windows and load-test slots
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Alice Donovan <alice.donovan@acme-corp.com>, Tim Wright <tim.wright@finlytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Multishift bootcamp — aligning hands-on windows and load-test slots

Hi Alice / Tim,

Thanks again for agreeing to a hands-on POC with Redwood. To make the deep-dive and load rehearsals productive for your engineering teams across NA/EMEA/APAC, I put together a proposed multi-shift plan (attached). The goals are:

- Run three 90–120 minute hands-on sessions (US, EU, APAC) over a rolling week so your teams can participate in their local business hours.
- Reserve two 60-minute load test windows (one warmup, one stress run) with the same session leads.
- Allocate a single 60-minute prompt review slot for prompts/routing checks before the load tests.

Ask: could you confirm 2–3 people per region who will join the hands-on sessions and their preferred local windows? I mapped out candidate slots in the attached POC-schedule-grid.xlsx (columns: UTC start, region-friendly label).

Proposed first-round slots (UTC):
- US window: 15:00 UTC (morning PT / mid-day ET)
- EU window: 09:00 UTC (late morning CET)
- APAC window: 01:00 UTC (early evening JST/SGT)

Notes: we plan rotating session leads so the same Redwood engineers can support across waves. Dev and Lauren are cc'd to coordinate load-test configs and prompt review.

Attachments: POC-schedule-grid.xlsx; prompt-playbook-v1.pdf (draft prompt sets + routing checklist).

If those high-level times look feasible, I will lock invites and publish a shared sheet for attendees to pick slots.

Thanks,

--
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Thanks, Aditya — this looks good. A few quick items from our side:

- We have engineering coverage in NA and EU; APAC will be represented but with one primary contact (Akira Sato).
- For the APAC wave, could you shift the slot 1 hour later to accommodate a 19:00 JST start?
- Can the prompt review be recorded? Some of our team will review asynchronously.

I'll confirm names by EOD Thursday.

Best,
Alice
